title: update_agent
description: Install a signed agent release (POST /api/system/deploy-update, online targets only). The agent verifies the ed25519 signature over the exact decoded `manifest` bytes with its built-in release public key, parses the manifest (release-manifest.json), requires a version newer than its own and exactly one agent package, downloads it from `<ServerUrl>/updates/<name>` and checks its size and SHA-256 before installing. Nothing in this message is trusted without the signature. The result comes back later as `update_result`.

manifest.description: Standard base64 of the signed manifest.json bytes, unchanged. The decoded bytes follow release-manifest.json.

manifest_sig.description: Base64 ed25519 signature (64 bytes) of the decoded `manifest` bytes (manifest.json.sig).
